contract.review_cycle: Per course milestone, or on any change to upstream intake fields
contract.steward_role: Data / Model owner, per enterprise_risk_policy.md section on data lineage and version control
contract.disclaimer: Synthetic dataset built for a Data Engineering for AI course project. Values, thresholds and rules are simulation assumptions and do not represent real lender underwriting standards or regulatory requirements.

business_definition.summary: One record per consumer loan application submitted for a credit product, capturing the applicant financial profile, the product requested, the automated preliminary decision produced at intake, and the final underwriting decision once one is made.
business_definition.business_process: Loan origination: intake, preliminary screening and final decision. The record is created when an application is submitted and the intake screen runs. The intake fields sit upstream of underwriting, escalation, and funding; final_decision and final_decision_date record the underwriting outcome when it is reached.
answers_questions: What did the applicant ask for, and under which product?
What was the applicant's credit and financial profile at the moment of application?
What did the automated intake screen decide, and what still needs a human?
How does application volume, mix, and preliminary outcome vary by product, state and risk tier?
does_not_answer: Whether the loan was funded or priced. final_decision records Approved, Declined or Withdrawn and its date, but no funded amount, rate or term.

Which product gate an application failed. preliminary_decision applies the loan_product.csv gates and the tier overlay but records only the outcome; recompute the gates from loan_product.csv (restated in product_eligibility_rules.md) to see which one failed.
The applicant's current credit profile. Every value is as-of the application date, not as-of today.
Repayment, delinquency, or servicing outcomes — no post-origination performance data exists in this dataset.
business_definition.in_scope: Applications across three product lines (Mortgage, Credit Card, Auto), three tiers each, in a four-state pilot footprint (CA, FL, NC, TX), application dates 2024-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
business_definition.out_of_scope: Applications outside the four pilot states, products outside the nine codes in loan_product.csv, incomplete applications that were never submitted (applications withdrawn after submission are in scope and carry final_decision Withdrawn), and any application-level identity, demographic or contact data.

grain.cardinality_notes: In this snapshot each applicant submits exactly one application, so applicant grain and application grain coincide 1:1. Consumers must not rely on that coincidence: if the simulation later allows repeat applicants, application_id alone will no longer identify the applicant and a separate applicant key will be required. Count applications with COUNT(*), never COUNT(DISTINCT application_id), so the metric survives that change.
grain.fan_out_warning: Joining to credit_pull_event.csv is 1:many (1775 events across 580 applications, 1 to 5 each; the 20 NO_HISTORY applications have none) and will duplicate application rows. Aggregate the event stream to one row per application before joining, or any sum over requested_amount_usd will be inflated. Use a left join so the 20 applications without pulls are not dropped.

annual_income_usd.notes: Self-reported gross annual income, unverified at intake. Delivered as a formatted string with a currency symbol, thousands separators and a trailing space; must be cast to integer before any arithmetic.

requested_amount_usd.notes: Amount the applicant asked for, not an approved or funded amount. May legitimately exceed the product maximum in loan_product.csv (25 rows do).

employment_duration_months.notes: Tenure at current employer as of the application date. Not a total work-history figure.

fico_score.scale: integer, bounded 300-850; empty for the 20 NO_HISTORY applicants
fico_score.notes: Dimensionless index. Never average across products or tiers as if it were a continuous measure of creditworthiness without stating the population. An empty value means no score exists, not zero; exclude it from any average and state the exclusion.

dti_pct.notes: CRITICAL: this is a percent, not a 0-1 ratio. It is also NOT the same measure as applicant_risk_features.debt_burden_ratio, which is an unbounded stock-of-debt-to-income ratio (0.0804-2.376). The two do not convert into one another and must never be substituted for each other.

boolean_flags.notes: Delivered as uppercase string literals. Absence of a flag means the condition was not observed at intake, not that it was verified as false.

date.timezone: Naive local date; no time component and no timezone is carried.

final_decision.scale: Approved / Declined / Withdrawn, or empty while the application is open
final_decision.notes: Unordered outcome labels. Empty is a distinct open state, not a missing value to impute; any final approval rate must state whether open and Withdrawn rows are in the denominator.

final_decision_date.format_delivered: M/D/YYYY, not zero-padded, same as date; empty exactly when final_decision is empty
final_decision_date.notes: Date the final decision was made, on or after the application date and on or before the 2026-09-14 extract date. It is NOT the as-of anchor; date is.

point_in_time_semantics.as_of_meaning: The application submission date. Every intake field in the row is a snapshot of what was known or reported AT that date. The exceptions are final_decision and final_decision_date, which record the later underwriting outcome and carry their own date. The intake fields are a frozen observation, not a live profile.
point_in_time_semantics.temporal_nature: Immutable intake snapshot. A later credit pull or a change in the applicant's risk tier does not rewrite this record. The only fields filled after intake are final_decision and final_decision_date, which are empty while the application is open and set when it is decided.
point_in_time_semantics.no_lookahead_rule: Per applicant_risk_policy.md, any feature used for risk classification must be derivable from information available on or before the application date. The intake fields satisfy that by construction; final_decision and final_decision_date do not, because they postdate the application, and must never be used as inputs to an intake-time decision. Consumers joining external data MUST filter that data to event_date <= date, or they introduce target leakage.
point_in_time_semantics.correct_join_pattern: To attach credit history, select from credit_pull_event.csv only events where event_date <= loan_application.date, then take the latest per application. No pull in the current data falls after its own application date, but the filter must stay in place; joining an unfiltered event stream would leak post-application information into a pre-application decision.
point_in_time_semantics.reconstruction_note: This file's fico_score is derived from credit_pull_event.csv: it is the fico_score of the latest pull with a returned score (Completed or Resubmitted) on or before the application date, and it reproduces for 580 of 580 scored applications. It is empty for the 20 NO_HISTORY applicants, who have no pulls. Recompute it from the event stream to validate lineage, never to replace it with a later pull.

future_dated_rows.condition: date is later than the 2026-09-14 processing date, extending to 2026-12-31
future_dated_rows.interpretation: The snapshot is a full-calendar simulation rather than a to-date extract. These rows still carry a preliminary_decision but never a final_decision; ingestion quarantines them (owned by the Data & Ingestion Lead).
future_dated_rows.consumer_requirement: Pipelines must make an explicit, documented choice: accept the full calendar range, or filter to date <= processing date. Silently dropping these rows changes volume, mix and approval-rate metrics without any error being raised.

point_in_time_semantics.slowly_changing_dimension_handling: Not applicable; this is a fact-style event table. FICO, which changes over time, is captured as of the application date only, and its history lives in credit_pull_event.csv. The applicant risk tier is not carried here at all; it lives in applicant_risk_features.csv, as of the same date.

source_of_truth.system_of_record: Loan origination intake system (simulated). This file is the authoritative record for what was submitted, what the intake screen preliminarily decided, and the final underwriting decision.
authoritative_for: application_id as the application identifier across the project
date — the application date used as the as-of anchor by every other dataset
military_scra_flag, bankruptcy_last_7y_flag, collections_past_12_months_flag as declared at intake
final_decision and final_decision_date: the underwriting outcome (Approved, Declined, Withdrawn) and the date it was made

not_authoritative_for.authoritative_source: applicant_risk_features.csv (risk_tier), governed by applicant_risk_policy.md, policy RISK-TIER v1.0
not_authoritative_for.reason: This file carries no tier. The former credit_risk_tier column, a FICO band that reused the T1-T5 labels, was dropped on 2026-10-01. The only applicant tier is risk_tier, computed from delinquency, debt-burden and overdue-amount points over a 24-month lookback; join it on application_id.

not_authoritative_for.authoritative_source: credit_pull_event.csv (fico_score of the latest returned pull on or before the application date)
not_authoritative_for.reason: This file's fico_score is a derived copy of a pull result, not an independent intake capture. If the two ever disagree, the event stream is the source and the disagreement is a lineage defect.

not_authoritative_for.authoritative_source: Distinct measure; applicant_risk_features.debt_burden_ratio is a different metric, not a corrected version of this one
not_authoritative_for.reason: Different definitions and different scales. Neither supersedes the other; report whichever you use by its full name.

preliminary_decision applies each product's gates in loan_product.csv (restated in the Catalog Gates table of product_eligibility_rules.md) and records only the outcome. Thresholds inferred from decision outcomes would be approximations of values that are published exactly in the catalog; read them from the catalog.

not_authoritative_for.authoritative_source: Not present in this project's data
not_authoritative_for.reason: This file stops at the final decision. Review cases route to human underwriting per approval_escalation_procedures.md and their outcome is recorded in final_decision, but no funded amount, rate or term is captured for any application anywhere in the corpus.

upstream_dependencies: Credit bureau pulls (credit_pull_event.csv), the source of fico_score
Applicant risk tier (applicant_risk_features.csv, risk_tier), used by the preliminary decision
Underwriting outcome, the source of final_decision
downstream_consumers: Retrieval / RAG index over the policy and application corpus
Any model that predicts or explains the preliminary decision

freshness.expected_cadence: Per project milestone for the course simulation; daily batch in the production analogue this simulates
freshness.max_acceptable_staleness: 24 hours in the production analogue; snapshot-stable for the duration of a project milestone
freshness.freshness_signal: MAX(date) within the file, compared against the expected coverage window
freshness.staleness_alerting: Raise a data-quality event if a new load reduces MAX(date), if row count moves by more than 10%, or if any new categorical value appears in region_state, product_code, preliminary_decision or final_decision.
freshness.late_arriving_data: Not expected for intake fields. final_decision and final_decision_date are filled after intake, so the 6 applications still open at the 2026-09-14 extract date can gain a decision in a later snapshot. Because this snapshot already contains future-dated rows, absence of recent rows is NOT a reliable staleness signal on its own; check row count and coverage window together.
freshness.backfill_policy: Full replacement. There is no incremental merge key other than application_id; intake fields are immutable once written, and only final_decision and final_decision_date can change between snapshots.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: Review (53 of 600, 8.8%) means 'routed to a human underwriter', not 'pending approval' and not a negative outcome. Any approval-rate metric must state its denominator, treat Review as a distinct third state, and say whether it is built on preliminary_decision or final_decision. Reporting approvals as 274/(274+273) and calling it a 50% approval rate is a misstatement: it silently discards the 53 Review cases, which resolve in final_decision to Approved 17, Declined 27, Withdrawn 4 and open 5.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: This file carries no risk tier; the only applicant tier is applicant_risk_features.risk_tier.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: The former credit_risk_tier column was a FICO band that reused the T1-T5 labels of the policy tier; it was dropped on 2026-10-01. Any tier attached to an application must come from applicant_risk_features.csv (risk_tier, policy RISK-TIER v1.0), joined on application_id. Do not re-derive a tier by banding fico_score: per product_risk_policy.md section 3, loan_product.minimum_risk_tier is tested against risk_tier, and fico_score is tested separately against minimum_fico. A FICO band labelled T1-T5 in any downstream artifact would be confused with the policy tier in a join.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: preliminary_decision follows the product rules, then the applicant-tier overlay.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: The rule reproduces all 600 rows. Declined if any loan_product.csv gate fails: requested amount above maximum_amount_usd, dti_pct above max_dti_pct, a bankruptcy or collections flag on a product that does not allow it, risk_tier worse than minimum_risk_tier, fico_score below minimum_fico, or no score on a product whose allow_no_score_flag is FALSE. Otherwise Review if credit_history_status is NO_HISTORY or LIMITED_HISTORY or risk_tier is T4 or T5 (product_risk_policy.md section 3); otherwise Approved. Counts: Approved 274, Declined 273, Review 53. Consequences: the bankruptcy and collections flags matter only on products that disallow them (5 approvals carry a bankruptcy flag and 14 a collections flag, all on products that allow it); employment tenure, state and SCRA status play no part at this stage, and income enters only indirectly through risk_tier. A model trained to predict preliminary_decision is therefore learning a published deterministic rule, not credit risk; it will appear near-perfect and add nothing the rule does not already state.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: requested_amount_usd is a request, never an approval.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: Do not aggregate it as originated volume, exposure or balance. 25 rows exceed the product maximum in loan_product.csv; 215 scored applications fall below the product minimum FICO, 11 unscored applications are on products that do not accept no score, 40 exceed the product DTI cap and 160 carry a risk_tier worse than the product minimum (a row can fail several gates). These are valid applications that failed eligibility and were preliminarily Declined, not corrupt records; that is precisely what an intake file is supposed to contain.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: Every value is as-of the application date.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: fico_score, dti_pct, employment_duration_months and the three flags describe the applicant at submission. Presenting them as current applicant state, or joining them to post-application events without a date filter, produces target leakage and is prohibited by applicant_risk_policy.md. final_decision and final_decision_date are the exception: they postdate the application and must never be used as inputs to an intake-time decision or model feature.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: dti_pct is a percent and is not interchangeable with debt_burden_ratio.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: Bounded 8.2-59.8 here; the risk-features measure, applicant_risk_features.debt_burden_ratio, is an unbounded 0.0804-2.376 debt-stock ratio. Multiplying one by 100 does not yield the other in any of the 580 rows where both are present (debt_burden_ratio is empty for the 20 NO_HISTORY applicants). Always qualify which measure is being reported; only dti_pct is tested against the product max_dti_pct.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: military_scra_flag is a protections marker, not a risk factor.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: It signals that servicemember protections such as rate caps apply (see scra_rate_cap_pct in loan_product.csv and the MLA notes in regional_state_lending_requirements.md). It must never be used as a predictor of creditworthiness or as a segmentation variable for adverse treatment. Under ECOA and the prohibited-factor list in applicant_risk_policy.md, using protected-status markers as risk inputs is not permitted.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: region_state carries regulatory meaning, not just geography.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: State determines which usury caps, disclosure and repossession rules apply per regional_state_lending_requirements.md. It is a compliance dimension. Do not collapse it into a generic region bucket in any artifact that feeds a decision or a disclosure.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: Absence of a flag is absence of evidence.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: bankruptcy_last_7y_flag = FALSE means no bankruptcy was recorded at intake, not that the applicant was verified bankruptcy-free. Do not phrase downstream output as a verified negative.

business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.rule: Retrieval and RAG surfaces must carry the as-of date and the preliminary qualifier.
business_interpretation_consumers_must_p.detail: Any chunk, embedding, card or generated answer derived from a row must state the application date and the word 'preliminary' alongside preliminary_decision. Where final_decision is shown, it must be labelled final with its final_decision_date, and an empty final_decision must be shown as open. A retrieved snippet reading 'Application APP100012: Declined' without those qualifiers is a materially misleading representation of the record, and adverse-action accuracy is a live compliance concern per approval_escalation_procedures.md and ECOA.

field_semantics.application_id: Stable business key for the application. Format APP######. Join key to applicant_risk_features.csv (1:1) and credit_pull_event.csv (1:many; 580 of the 600 applications have pulls). Note that applicant_risk_features.csv also carries its own row key, appli_risk_id (LA######); do not join on that.
field_semantics.annual_income_usd: Self-reported gross annual income in whole USD, as declared at application. Unverified.
field_semantics.employment_duration_months: Whole months at current employer as of the application date.
field_semantics.fico_score: Credit bureau score, 300-850: the fico_score of the latest credit_pull_event.csv pull with a returned score on or before the application date. Empty for the 20 NO_HISTORY applicants, who have no pulls. Point-in-time; reconciles to the event stream for 580 of 580 scored applications. This file has no tier column; see BI-02.
field_semantics.region_state: Two-letter state of the applicant, determining the applicable state regulatory regime. Four-state pilot footprint.
field_semantics.requested_amount_usd: Amount requested in whole USD. Never an approved or funded amount.
field_semantics.product_code: Product applied for; foreign key to loan_product.csv. Encodes line and tier: MTG (mortgage) FH/CV/JB, CRD (credit card) SC/ST/EL, AUT (auto) SP/TR/TT.
field_semantics.dti_pct: Debt-to-income as a percent, as computed at intake. See BI-06.
field_semantics.military_scra_flag: TRUE where Servicemembers Civil Relief Act protections apply. Protections marker only. See BI-07.
field_semantics.bankruptcy_last_7y_flag: TRUE where a bankruptcy was recorded within seven years prior to application. Disqualifying in the preliminary screen only on products whose allow_bankruptcy_flag is FALSE. See BI-03.
field_semantics.collections_past_12_months_flag: TRUE where a collections event was recorded in the twelve months prior to application. Disqualifying in the preliminary screen only on products whose allow_collections_flag is FALSE. See BI-03.
field_semantics.preliminary_decision: Intake screening outcome: Approved, Review (routed to human underwriting), or Declined. Preliminary only; the underwriting outcome is final_decision. See BI-01 and BI-03.
field_semantics.date: Application submission date and the as-of anchor for every intake field in the row.
field_semantics.final_decision: Underwriting outcome: Approved, Declined or Withdrawn; empty while the application is open. Counts: Approved 242, Declined 266, Withdrawn 15, open 77 (the 71 applications dated after the 2026-09-14 extract date, which never carry a final decision, and 6 still open at that date). A preliminary Declined is never later Approved, and a preliminary Approved is never later Declined, though it can be Withdrawn. Postdates the application; see BI-05.
field_semantics.final_decision_date: Date the final decision was made, M/D/YYYY like date. Filled exactly when final_decision is filled; on or after the application date and on or before the 2026-09-14 extract date.

prohibited_uses: Using military_scra_flag, region_state, or any protected-status proxy as a risk or pricing input.
Presenting preliminary_decision as a final adverse action or as the basis for an adverse action notice.
Deriving per-product eligibility thresholds from preliminary_decision outcomes.
Joining post-application events to a row without a date filter for any feature used in a decision.
referenced_authorities: Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA) — prohibited bases and adverse action notice requirements
Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) — permissible purpose and accuracy of credit information
Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (SCRA) / Military Lending Act (MLA) — rate caps and protections
applicant_risk_policy.md — permitted and prohibited risk factors, 24-month lookback, no-lookahead principle
enterprise_risk_policy.md — data lineage, calculation definitions, version control and change records
compliance_notes.escalation: If a consumer finds a conflict between this contract and a policy document, hold the affected action and obtain documented resolution from the relevant owners, per enterprise_risk_policy.md section 3.

change_log.summary: Initial semantic contract. Grain, units, as-of semantics, source-of-truth boundaries, freshness expectations and ten mandatory interpretation rules derived from a full profile of the 600-row snapshot and cross-referenced against the project policy corpus.

Updated for the regenerated source data: credit_risk_tier removed, fico_score now derived from credit_pull_event.csv (empty for NO_HISTORY), final_decision and final_decision_date added, debt_to_income_ratio renamed debt_burden_ratio, and BI-01 to BI-06 and BI-10 rewritten for the product-rule preliminary decision and the new counts. Deliberate quality issues (money as text, M/D/YYYY dates, 71 future-dated rows) are unchanged.
